hook: Your photo of Easter Island's heads misses their bodies.
title: Easter Island's Giant Heads Have Buried Bodies
description:
The famous Easter Island moai are often called heads, but excavations found full torsos buried underground. Soil built up around many of them over time. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #EasterIsland #Geography
comment_prompt: Did you know this? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your photo of Easter Island's heads misses their bodies.
scenes.headline: Heads With Bodies

scenes.narration: They're called heads, but they're full statues.
scenes.headline: Full Statues

scenes.narration: Soil slowly buried them up to the shoulders.
scenes.headline: Buried By Soil

scenes.narration: Excavations dug down and found torsos below.
scenes.headline: Dug Up Torsos

scenes.narration: Some even have carvings on their backs.
scenes.headline: Carvings On Backs

scenes.narration: There are nearly 900 of these statues.
scenes.headline: Nearly 900 Statues

scenes.narration: Most were carved in one volcano's quarry.
scenes.headline: Carved In A Crater

scenes.narration: So your photo shows only the top.
scenes.headline: Only The Top

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: monkeys drawn in the Peruvian desert.
